story.iWant: Zustand stores configured for device, partition, flash, terminal, and settings state
story.soThat: React components can access and update app state in a predictable, type-safe manner

tasks.task: Install Zustand 1.1 Run `npm install zustand` 1.2 Verify zustand version 5.x in package.json 1.3 Ensure no peer dependency warnings
Create stores directory structure 2.1 Create `src/stores/` directory 2.2 Create `src/stores/index.ts` for re-exports 2.3 Define TypeScript interfaces for all state shapes
Create deviceStore 3.1 Create `src/stores/deviceStore.ts` 3.2 Define DeviceState interface 3.3 Implement actions: setDevice, setConnected, setError, reset 3.4 Export useDeviceStore hook

Create partitionStore 4.1 Create `src/stores/partitionStore.ts` 4.2 Define PartitionState interface 4.3 Implement actions: setPartitions, toggleSelection, selectAll, deselectAll, setSearchFilter 4.4 Export usePartitionStore hook

Create flashStore 5.1 Create `src/stores/flashStore.ts` 5.2 Define FlashState type and FlashContext interface 5.3 Implement actions: setStatus, setProgress, setCurrentPartition, setError, reset 5.4 Export useFlashStore hook

Create terminalStore 6.1 Create `src/stores/terminalStore.ts` 6.2 Define LogEntry interface 6.3 Define TerminalState with logs array 6.4 Implement actions: log(level, message), clear() 6.5 Generate unique id for each log entry 6.6 Export useTerminalStore hook

Create settingsStore with persistence 7.1 Create `src/stores/settingsStore.ts` 7.2 Import persist middleware from zustand/middleware 7.3 Define SettingsState interface 7.4 Implement actions: setLanguage, setShowWizard, setLastDeviceId 7.5 Configure persist middleware with localStorage key 'qflash-settings' 7.6 Export useSettingsStore hook
Create index.ts for exports 8.1 Update src/stores/index.ts to export all stores 8.2 Export all TypeScript interfaces
Verify implementation 9.1 Run npm run dev and verify no TypeScript errors 9.2 Test settingsStore persistence 9.3 Verify all stores can be imported from @/stores

doc.title: Q-Flash-Web Architecture
doc.snippet: Decision: Use Zustand for state management. Rationale: Lightweight (2KB vs 20KB+ Redux), less boilerplate, easy integration with existing logic, built-in persistence middleware.

doc.title: Q-Flash-Web Architecture
doc.snippet: All stores follow structure: interface with state and actions, create() function, persist middleware for localStorage. Use (set, get) pattern.

doc.title: Q-Flash-Web Architecture
doc.snippet: Defines deviceStore (selectedDevice, isConnected), partitionStore (partitions, selectedPartitions), flashStore (status, progress), settingsStore (language, showWizard, persisted).

interface.name: DeviceState
interface.signature: interface DeviceState { selectedDevice: DeviceProfile | null; isConnected: boolean; connectionError: string | null; firehoseLoaded: boolean; setDevice: (device: DeviceProfile | null) => void; setConnected: (connected: boolean) => void; setError: (error: string | null) => void; reset: () => void; }

interface.name: PartitionState
interface.signature: interface PartitionState { partitions: PartitionInfo[]; selectedPartitions: Set<string>; searchFilter: string; isLoading: boolean; setPartitions: (p: PartitionInfo[]) => void; toggleSelection: (name: string) => void; selectAll: () => void; deselectAll: () => void; setSearchFilter: (filter: string) => void; }

interface.name: SettingsState
interface.signature: interface SettingsState { language: 'en' | 'vi'; showWizard: boolean; lastDeviceId: string | null; setLanguage: (lang: 'en' | 'vi') => void; setShowWizard: (show: boolean) => void; setLastDeviceId: (id: string | null) => void; }

interface.name: PartitionInfo
interface.signature: interface PartitionInfo { name: string; startSector: bigint; endSector: bigint; sizeInSectors: bigint; sizeFormatted: string; typeGuid: string; uniqueGuid: string; attributes: bigint; }

interface.name: LogEntry
interface.signature: interface LogEntry { timestamp: Date; level: LogLevel; message: string; data?: unknown; }
